details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: A strongly shattered set of size d is the free-coordinate set of a contained d-cube.  Both labels occur on each of those coordinates, so all d coordinates belong to the effective range.
name: Effective Range / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
witness_verification: For #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $0$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
